decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display sits at the core of the firm's announced display focus and needed little extra investment, so management keeps it, although its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 raises the risk of withdrawal.
The pegboard-back display extends the core shelf range the firm has publicly promoted, and management still attributes weak demand to pandemic-era retail disruption rather than to the product itself.
The standard quarter-pallet display is central to the one-stop offering, so dropping it would contradict the firm's stated direction and earlier decisions to back it.
The media-product display serves a shrinking niche, but it is close to the core and was visibly launched, so management persists and attributes any weakness to temporary market conditions.
